image_description: A close-up, black-and-white photograph of a stack of audio cassette tapes. The primary subject is a single cassette in the foreground, angled slightly to the right. It features a transparent plastic shell, revealing the internal spools and magnetic tape. A white paper label with handwritten text ('City...') is affixed to the top face. The background consists of other cassettes stacked haphazardly, creating a textured, repetitive pattern.

The cassettes in the background exhibit slight 'melting' or loss of sharp geometric edges compared to the foreground subject, blending into each other more than physically expected.
